research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: August Home is researching intelligent door lock systems, as described in 'Video recording triggered by a smart lock device.' The abstract details a system where a door status device, coupled to a lock's drive shaft, assists in locking and unlocking at a dwelling. This system enables video recording to be triggered by the smart lock device, integrating access control with responsive monitoring. These efforts focus on enhancing home access and security through smart, behavior-responsive technologies.

overview_description.description:
August develops smarter home access products and services that allow physical environments to seamlessly respond to user behavior. Its flagship product, the August Smart Lock, is a new home access system that allows you to use smartphones in place of traditional keys.

August is founded by famed designer Yves Behar and consumer technology veteran Jason Johnson and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

product.name: August Wi-Fi Smart Lock
product.description: A smart lock that enables keyless home entry and remote access via Wi-Fi, compatible with most single cylinder deadbolts.

product.name: Yale Approach™ Lock with Wi-Fi
product.description: A smart lock with built-in Wi-Fi and keypad, offering keyless entry and remote control through mobile apps.

product.name: Yale Keypad Touch
product.description: A fingerprint access keypad that pairs with smart locks to provide secure, keyless entry via fingerprint and key codes.

product.name: August Connect Wi-Fi Bridge
product.description: A device that connects August smart locks to Wi-Fi, enabling remote access and control from anywhere.

product.name: August Smart Lock with Keypad
product.description: A smart lock combined with a keypad for keyless entry using custom key codes, allowing phone-free access.

product.name: August Smart Deadbolt with Wi-Fi
product.description: A traditional deadbolt enhanced with Wi-Fi smart lock capabilities for remote and keyless access.
